description.value:
Your coloration camouflages you nicely in aquatic environments, and you know how to take full advantage of that. While underwater, you can [[/act sneak]] without attempting a Stealth check as long as you move no more than 5 feet and do not pass within 10 feet of an enemy during your movement.

You can move at full Speed while using the [[/act avoid-notice]] exploration activity in an aquatic environment, and you can use another exploration activity that does not attract unnecessary attention while Avoiding Notice.
